items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: We were roommates. So we both left. Get to our Slam he needed... So Jose called him... Dalton Russo, a trumpet player... That's how we were together.

ctx.x: Yeah, because we got in an incident late on over the river there where we all had to leave. Prevost's bass got broke up. And right, that was before I ever thought about leaving. But Joe had a disagreement with one of the guys in the band and he fired him. I said, well if you fired him I'm going to leave too. Dalton. And when he left we went with Guitar Slam then. That was in 54. Who was it? That's how I went with Guitar Slam. Joe Jones. Who was the other guy? Dalton Russo, a trumpet player. Yeah. He played with…
